newsitem.title: UK: S&P says may raise Protector rating, affirms Zurich.
newsitem.headline: S&P says may raise Protector rating, affirms Zurich.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Thursday it had placed its BBB claims-paying ability rating of Protector Forsikring ASA (Protector) on Creditwatch with positive implications.
At the same time, the claims-paying ability rating of Zurich Insurance Company (Zurich) is affirmed at AA plus, S&P said in a statement.
"This action follows the announcement that Zurich plans to acquire 100 percent of Protector's share capital," said S&P.

"The positive implications for Protector are primarily the competitive advantages that ownership by a major global insurance group will bring, including improved financial flexibility and access to an international network of offices through which it can service its clients' global insurance needs," the agency said.
"In view of the relatively modest size of the acquisition, S&P believes that it will have an extremely limited impact on Zurich's financial strength," it said.

S&P said Protector was listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange in 1992 and had developed rapidly its position in the international marine and energy insurance markets and the Norwegian commercial/industrial sector.

"The purchase price includes a premium of 38 percent over the recent average share price. In addition, the offer is conditional upon regulatory approval, the necessary due diligence, and more than 90 percent of the share capital being rendered to Zurich," S&P said.
S&P said it expected senior management at Protector would remain unchanged and that, going forward, the company would operate within Zurich as an autonomous business unit.
